claims.assertion: Yazhi says Taygetan magnetic-impulse craft can condense suspended atmospheric silicates into fragile borosilicate fibers through controlled plasma-jet frequencies and heat; particulates must be present.
claims.speaker: Yazhi

claims.assertion: Yazhi distinguishes weak, touch-dissolving silicate fibers from stronger web-like fibers, which she says are probably graphene; she says laboratory analysis is needed to distinguish them.
claims.speaker: Yazhi
